abilities.name: Enigmatic Feint
_curatorNotes: behavior: 'stance' changed to 'instant' — the Hold E Pilfering Shadow movement phase does not replace Lynette's normal/charged attacks. Stance is reserved for N-replacement mechanics (Hu Tao, Cyno, Raiden, Furina).

Hold E Pilfering Shadow state: duration-bounded self-state with no spawned entity. Player controls movement; Shadowsign is applied to nearest enemy at 0.1s intervals. State ends on re-press or release. Duration is parametric (see Hold variant). Reviewer to decide self-buff/state representation.

Surging Blade (Arkhe: Ousia): fires with each Enigma Thrust use subject to skillAlignedICD=10s (600f). Press E: fires at frame 58 from cast start (skillPressAlignedHitmark). Hold E: fires at duration+44f from cast start (duration+skillHoldEndAlignedHitmark). Element: Anemo, Ousia-aligned. Not authored as effect — needs reviewer pass.

Heal authored (capability sweep 2026-07-28): gcsim skill.go:208-221 makeSkillHealAndDrainCB — on Enigma Thrust enemy hit, once per cast, Heal Src=0.25*MaxHP to self; fixed 25% (not talent-scaled). Both Tap and Hold attach the same callback (skill.go:80-99/104-121), so onHit skill covers both variants. The drain half (skill.go:224-241: 6% CurrentHP/s for 4s, 3 ticks at 60f intervals starting 1s after hit) has no schema primitive — surfaced in the caveat.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — The heal it hangs off draws nothing (no planner consumer for cast/onHit heal effects), and there is no HP anywhere in the sim — `src/lib/sim/` carries no HP or absorption state at all. A drain on an unrendered heal, expressed in a resource the tool does not have, cannot repair a confusion on screen. Category: invisible-omission.

variants.label: Hold
_curatorNotes: Frames recorded at minimum hold (hold param=1, internal duration=35f). Formula: skillHoldEndFrames[action]+duration where duration=clamp(hold,1,150)+34. At max hold (hold=150, duration=184f): swap=211, N=213, E=213, Q=213, D=212, J=215.

cooldownStartDelay for Hold = duration + skillHoldEndCDStart (14f). At min hold: 35+14=49f; at max hold: 184+14=198f. Schema gap: AbilityVariant has no cooldownStartDelay field — reviewer to decide extension.

↻ 2026-10-30 (memory-triage round): `cooldownStartDelay: 49` authored on the Hold variant, now that a variant can state its own (it used to inherit the base's 26). gcsim skill.go SetCDWithDelay(..., duration+skillHoldEndCDStart); at the authored minimum hold duration = 1+34 = 35 (landing 51 = 35+16), so 35+14 = 49. The schema-gap note above is superseded.

abilities.description:
Flicks her mantle and executes an Enigma Thrust, dealing Anemo DMG.
When the Enigma Thrust hits an opponent, it will restore Lynette's HP based on her Max HP, and in the 4s afterward, she will lose a certain amount of HP per second.
Based on whether you press or hold this ability, she will use Enigma Thrust differently.

Press
She swiftly uses an Enigma Thrust.

Hold
Lynette will enter a high-speed Pilfering Shadow state and apply Shadowsign to a nearby opponent. You can control her movement direction during this state, and you can end it prematurely by using this skill again.
When this high-speed state ends, Lynette will unleash her Enigma Thrust. If there is an opponent with Shadowsign applied to them nearby, Lynette will approach them in a flash before using Enigma Thrust.

A maximum of 1 opponent can have Shadowsign at any one time. When this opponent gets too far from Lynette, the Shadowsign will be canceled.

Arkhe: Ousia
At specific intervals, Lynette will unleash a Surging Blade when she uses Enigma Thrust, dealing Ousia-aligned Anemo DMG.

abilities.name: Magic Trick: Astonishing Shift

_curatorNotes: gcsim internal/characters/lynette/bogglecatbox.go newBogglecatBox(): bogglecatAI Mult = bogglecat[c.TalentLvlBurst()], Element Anemo, Durability 25, ICDTag ElementalBurst / ICDGroup Default (standard ICD, so no icdGate). Loop `for t := burstFirstTick - burstSpawn; t <= b.Duration; t += burstTickInterval` = 11 ticks.
Cadence from burst.go consts: burstTickInterval = 59f -> 0.983s; burstFirstTick = 136f and burstSpawn = 14f, both cast-relative, so firstTickDelay = (136 - 14)/60 = 2.033s from spawn.

Scaling from zz_lynette.dm.go `bogglecat` array index 9 (talent lvl 10) = 0.9216 -> 92.16. Sidecar docs/curation/talents/lynette.json burst row 'Bogglecat Box DMG' 10th value = 92.2% (genshin-db rounds to 1dp); gcsim's exact value preferred.

Absorbed element (absorption round, 2026-10-17; gcsim 4eda9fc5f lynette/bogglecatbox.go:72-145): the box polls on its think — first at 32f (gadget added at 14), every 18f, to its end (41 polls), C > P > H > E. On the lock, Vivid Shots every 134f from the lock, each landing 15f after its volley (first at lock + 149f), 1U, ICDTagElementalBurstAnemo / Default — its OWN counter (the box's ticks are ICDTagElementalBurst). 82.08% at talent 10. ⚓ Nate: the aura door only — a teammate hitting the box is not modelled, no caveat. Not modelled: A4 (fired on lock). ⚓ `travel: 15` — the box bounds the VOLLEY, not the landing (gcsim `t <= b.Duration`; ⚓ Nate 2026-10-18), so a shot fired at or before the box's end lands up to 15f after it.
C2's second Vivid Shot per volley (gcsim 4eda9fc5f lynette/cons.go:18 vividCount = 2) — the same volley, on the SAME counter (icdCounter 'vividShot'), so the pair spends one standard window.

Vivid Shots are NOT authored as a tick series: they only exist after elemental absorption, their element is the absorbed one (not Lynette's), and gcsim queues them on a separate ICDTagElementalBurstAnemo counter. C2 doubles them (vividCount=2) and affects nothing about the Bogglecat Box ticks above.

Elemental Absorption: Bogglecat Box absorbs one of Pyro/Hydro/Cryo/Electro once per use (via HandleAttack or absorbCheck every 0.3s). After absorption, fires Vivid Shots of that element at burstVividInterval=134f (~2.2s) intervals for remaining duration. Reviewer to decide effect-row representation.

After elemental absorption, b.Kill() removes the box from the hittable gadget list but all vivid shot tasks are already queued and continue to run. Box duration is burstDuration=754f (12.6s) from spawn regardless of when absorption occurs.
abilities.description:
Lynette raises her mantle high, dealing AoE Anemo DMG, using skillful sleight of hand to make a giant Bogglecat Box appear!

Bogglecat Box
·Taunts nearby opponents, attracting their attacks.
·Deals Anemo DMG to nearby opponents at intervals.
·When the Bogglecat Box comes into contact with Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, it will gain the corresponding element and additionally fire Vivid Shots that will deal DMG from that element at intervals.
Elemental Absorption of this kind will only occur once during this ability's duration.
